audit.whatIsWrong: Both layers had Level 2, Level 6 and 2+ items marked Urgot/Skill against the packet levelChart and against the mirror audit (urgot__zaahen), which set rows 1 and 4 to Skill and row 6 to Zaahen. The content whys already read 'stays neutral', 'even/skill' and 'you take over', so the win[] tokens contradicted their own explanations.
audit.why: 50.98% over 814 games with a Zaahen-favoured two-item window matches the packet chart, not the all-Urgot version on disk.
audit.corrected: win[1]/phases[1].side -> Skill, win[4]/phases[4].side -> Skill, win[6]/phases[6].side -> Zaahen, proposed as one atomic group with matching ratings.

audit.whatIsWrong: The level-6 spike text described the R as chaining and terrifying nearby minions and champions — not in Riot's description, which says it impales the first champion hit and allows an execute below a threshold.
audit.why: Riot's text is the authority; the extra fear-splash claim is unverified.
audit.corrected: spikes[1].text rewritten with the real behaviour plus the 100/85/70s cooldown and 2500 range.
sources: brief enemyKit R text and flags

audit.whatIsWrong: Disdain was called 'his engage' with no range or cooldown, and its shield was never mentioned. Purge was treated as an unavoidable shred window when it is 490 range and slows Urgot himself. Zaahen's 850-range W pull outranging both was absent.
audit.why: Disdain is 16/15.5/15/14.5/14s at 475 range and shields him as he charges, so bursting into the charge feeds the shield. Purge's self-slow plus 490 range means walking out is a real answer.
audit.corrected: dosFull[0].d, dosFull[1].d, dontsFull[0].d, dontsFull[1].d, dontsFull[2].d and breakdown.cooldowns now carry the ranges, cooldowns, the shield and the pull.

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.cooldowns named no numbers and used the placeholder 'Your committal tool'.
audit.why: Disdain's 16s at rank 1 is the punishable window in this lane.
audit.corrected: Rewritten with Disdain, Purge and the W pull.

edits.before: Fear the Fear Beyond Death (R) execute — below the threshold his R chains you and terrifies nearby minions/champions; don't take a level-6 trade that leaves you executable, and save your R to survive the burst window.
edits.after: Fear Beyond Death is 100s at rank 1 and reaches 2500 units, impaling the first champion it hits and executing you under the threshold; don't take a level-6 trade that leaves you low, and hold your R to heal back above it.

edits.before: His engage. Dodge it. Only engage once it is down or baited.
edits.after: Disdain is 16s at rank 1 and only 475 range. Step in after it.

edits.before: Probe Urgot's pattern early, then commit your full combo only on his key cooldown — bank knowledge before blood.
edits.after: Disdain is 16s at rank 1 and only 475 range — sidestep the charge and you own the next fifteen seconds of lane.

edits.before: That is Urgot's favourite window — refuse it and half his win condition is gone.
edits.after: Purge is only 490 range and slows him — walk out of it and he cannot follow.

edits.before: Burning it for tiny value leaves you naked for its full cooldown.
edits.after: Disdain shields him on the charge — get flipped and you eat his full W.

edits.before: Coin-flipping into an unknown matchup — respect what you have not seen until you have seen it twice.
edits.after: Fear Beyond Death reaches 2500 units and executes below the threshold — break off while you are above it.

edits.before: - Urgot Disdain: matchup-defining — His engage. Dodge it. Track it before every engage. - Your committal tool: never spend it on chip. - Your ultimate: the win condition — kill windows only.
edits.after: - Urgot Disdain: 16s at rank 1, 475 range — his only engage. Dodge it, then step in. - Purge: 490 range and slows him; walk out. - Your W: an 850-range pull outranges both. - Your R: kill windows only.
